 Order

The present petition filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks quashing of FIR No.
644/2020 registered under Sections 498A/328/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Baba Haridas Nagar, Delhi and all other proceedings emanating therefrom, on the basis of compromise between the Petitioners and Respondent No. 2.
2.
After making submissions for some time, Ms. Astha, counsel for the Petitioners, states that she would like to withdraw the present petition.

3. Dismissed as withdrawn along with pending application(s).
4.
The Court has not commented on the merits of the case.
All rights and contentions of the parties are left open.
